title: oil stocks us strategic petroleum reserve fall by 37 million barrels lowest 2026 08 24
text:
Aug 24 (Reuters) - Stocks of crude ​oil in the ‌U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve ​fell ​by about 3.7 million ⁠barrels ​to 289.7 million ​barrels last week, the lowest ​level since ​November 1982, according ‌to ⁠data from the Department of Energy.
The ​drawdowns ​are ⁠part of a ​U.S. agreement ​to ⁠release 172 million barrels ⁠from ​the ​facility.
